'''Loranda''' was the mother of [[Hetton]]. She never knew of her son's [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitivity]] until he was in his twenties, at which point she hired the [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Gula Dwan]] to train her son in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. Loranda's family was very wealthy and able to pay the Dwan a considerable fee, but when Loranda released Dwan of his duties, she realized that he was a threat to their secret and had Hetton [[Death/Legends|kill]] him.

Loranda eventually came to admire the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] as her son did, and urged him to join the [[Brotherhood of Darkness/Legends|Brotherhood of Darkness]]. When Hetton refused, Loranda was determined to tell the Brotherhood about him anyway; something Hetton predicted, and therefore he killed her himself by poisoning her in her sleep.

Hetton later named [[Loranda (starship)|his starship]] after her.
